exercises.title: Fix the Bug
description: This code is supposed to change the first value in a point from 3
to 99. Run it and see what actually happens.
Tuples are immutable, just like strings —
once created, none of their individual items can be reassigned. To
get a "changed" version, you have to build a brand new tuple, often
reusing the parts you want to keep.
